noVaults.title: Back up and recover your files
noVaults.description: Create an encrypted vault in storage you provide, or connect a vault to recover existing backups.

card.destinationUsage: Usage of the entire destination drive or bucket, including data outside this vault.
card.estimatedUsage: Estimated vault storage from indexed packed data and metadata. Provider overhead is not included.

createDialog.description: Choose an empty destination for a new encrypted vault.
createDialog.connectDescription: Choose the storage containing your vault. You will need its existing encryption password.

validationError.title: Couldn't verify storage settings
validationError.rcloneRemoteNotConfigured: The rclone remote '{{remote}}' isn't configured on this computer. Check the remote name in your rclone config and try again.

existsError.title: Vault already exists
existsError.description: This vault is already connected on this computer under the name "{{name}}".

warning.title: Never forget this password
warning.description: Keep this encryption password somewhere safe. DiskPond cannot reset it. You will need it to restore your backups on another computer.

details.connectHint: Use the existing vault password. Connecting may copy legacy repository metadata to its current names; existing backups are preserved.

connectionErrors.password: The encryption password is incorrect. Enter the existing vault password, including any spaces.
connectionErrors.exists: This destination already contains a vault. Use Connect an existing vault, or choose an empty destination.
connectionErrors.notEmpty: This destination contains files or repository data. Choose an empty destination; do not remove existing backups to continue.
connectionErrors.missing: No vault was found here. Check the destination, or use Create a new vault for an empty destination.
connectionErrors.duplicate: This vault is already connected on this computer. Open it from the vault list.
connectionErrors.invalid: The repository identity could not be read. Check that this is a complete, compatible vault.
connectionErrors.destinationMissing: The destination folder is missing or is not a folder. Reconnect the drive or choose an existing folder.
connectionErrors.unavailable: The vault could not be opened. Check the destination, access permissions, provider credentials and repository files, then retry.

setup.title: Set up vault
setup.description: You need to configure this vault before using it.

protected.title: Vault credential storage
protected.description: DiskPond uses this computer's secure storage to save vault passwords and provider connections. Keep your passwords and storage credentials separately for recovery on another computer.

session.title: Vault credentials are session-only
session.description: Some credentials cannot be saved securely and stay in memory until DiskPond quits. After restarting, enter the requested vault password and provider connection details before scheduled backups can resume.
session.recovery: Restore access to your system key store, then restart DiskPond to try saving credentials again.

locked.title: Re-enter your vault credentials
locked.description: Saved credentials could not be unlocked or migrated. Open the affected vault and enter its password and any requested provider connection details. Its backups remain in your storage.

cleanupFailed.title: Saved credentials need cleanup
cleanupFailed.description: DiskPond could not migrate or remove an old credential copy. Check access to DiskPond's application data folder and restart to retry. The old copy may still be unprotected on disk.

unknown.title: Credential storage status is unavailable
unknown.description: Restart DiskPond to check credential storage. Keep your vault passwords and provider connection details available for re-entry.

passwordStorage.saveFailed: Credentials could not be saved. Check access to DiskPond's application data folder before restarting.

starting.title: Starting vault
starting.description: Your vault is being initialized. This usually takes a few seconds.
